threat_event: Ransomware encrypts the CAD application server and dispatch consoles, forcing manual dispatch
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No endpoint detection and response; dispatch consoles unpatched for 7 months; flat headquarters network; manual dispatch not drilled since 2023
existing_controls: MFA on email and cloud console; signature antivirus; county P25 radios at dispatch and in every unit
treatment_plan: MSP-managed EDR with 24x7 alerting on consoles and servers; monthly console patching with a CAD compatibility test; segment dispatch; quarterly manual dispatch drills

threat_event: CAD database snapshots, integration engine images, and call recordings are deleted or encrypted along with production
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Backup vault in the same account and region; not immutable; never restore-tested
existing_controls: Daily backups; 7-day point-in-time restore on the CAD database
treatment_plan: Separate backup account with immutable retention and a second region; quarterly restore tests of the CAD database and integration engine

threat_event: PHI in the CAD database and call recordings is exfiltrated during a ransomware attack (double extortion)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No egress monitoring; recordings archive readable by the CAD service account
regulatory_driver: C-EMERGENCY-R04 (164.312(b)); 45 CFR 164.404-164.408 (Breach Notification Rule); Fla. Stat. 501.171
existing_controls: Cloud network rules allow inbound only from VPN and county ranges
treatment_plan: Egress filtering and alerts on large transfers; restrict archive access to a separate read role; central log review

threat_event: Attacker exploits an unpatched operating system flaw on a dispatch console
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Consoles excluded from automatic patching for CAD client compatibility; last patched 7 months ago
existing_controls: Consoles have no direct internet browsing by policy (not enforced)
treatment_plan: Monthly patch window with a pre-tested CAD client; authenticated vulnerability scanning

threat_event: Dispatcher misuses CAD (for example, looks up a neighbor's or public figure's call history) and the action cannot be attributed
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Shared position logins at consoles; no CAD activity review
existing_controls: Badge-controlled dispatch room; dispatchers sign confidentiality agreements
treatment_plan: Named CAD accounts federated to the identity provider; monthly CAD query review by the Communications Center Supervisor

threat_event: Former field employee signs in to the ePCR after leaving and views patient records
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: ePCR accounts managed outside the identity provider; disabled up to 3 weeks after departure
existing_controls: HR emails IT and the Clinical Services Coordinator at departure
treatment_plan: Federate the ePCR to the identity provider; same-day disable triggered by the HR ticket; monthly reconciliation

threat_event: Attacker logs in to an internet-exposed vehicle router with the default password, disrupts AVL and mobile data, or pivots over the VPN
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 3 of 9 routers expose remote web administration with the manufacturer default password (found in P07 testing)
existing_controls: Routers are behind carrier NAT on 6 of 9 units
treatment_plan: Remote administration disabled and passwords changed on 2026-08-14; enroll all routers in the vendor management platform with unique credentials; quarterly configuration check

threat_event: CAD is unavailable for more than 1 hour because of a cloud region failure or a CAD software fault
threat_source: Cloud provider or CAD vendor failure
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single region; no documented recovery runbook with the CAD vendor
existing_controls: Managed database with zone redundancy; CAD vendor remote support
treatment_plan: CAD recovery runbook with the vendor; tested restore to a second region; manual dispatch drills

threat_event: Hurricane, fire, or extended power loss makes the headquarters dispatch center unusable
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No alternate dispatch site; manual dispatch not drilled since 2023
existing_controls: UPS and standby generator; two ISPs; CAD is reachable from any laptop over the VPN
treatment_plan: Alternate dispatch position at Station 2 (laptops, radio control station, printed run cards); overflow agreement with the county PSAP; annual relocation drill before hurricane season

threat_event: The county CAD-to-CAD interface fails and 911 incidents stop arriving electronically
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No interface monitoring; single integration engine VM
existing_controls: County PSAP also transfers callers by phone and announces calls on radio
treatment_plan: Heartbeat monitoring and alerts on the interface; written fallback procedure agreed with the county PSAP

threat_event: Business email compromise of the billing mailbox leads to payment diversion or PHI exposure
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: PCS forms and face sheets in a shared mailbox; no phishing training
existing_controls: MFA on email
treatment_plan: Phishing training and quarterly simulations; mailbox auditing; call-back verification for payment changes

threat_event: Call recordings containing PHI are disclosed by the hosted phone vendor, which has no BAA
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No BAA; no vendor security review
existing_controls: Vendor's standard terms
treatment_plan: Execute a BAA or move to a vendor that signs one

threat_event: AI triage vendor keeps call audio longer than needed or uses it to train models
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: AI module enabled under an order form with unreviewed data-use terms
existing_controls: CAD vendor BAA covers hosting support only
treatment_plan: BAA amendment covering the AI service with no-training, retention, and deletion terms (see P10)

threat_event: AI triage suggests too low a priority for a critical call after the pilot moves to advisory mode, delaying response
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Model accuracy not yet validated by caller language or age; no go-live criteria
regulatory_driver: 45 CFR 92.210 (if used to support clinical decisions); C-EMERGENCY-R04
existing_controls: Shadow mode only: suggestions are logged, not shown to dispatchers
treatment_plan: Go-live gate: validation and bias thresholds in P10; dispatcher protocol always governs; Medical Director sign-off

threat_event: Lost or stolen ePCR tablet exposes patient records
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Tablets leave the station on every call
existing_controls: Full-disk encryption; remote wipe; ePCR app requires sign-in
treatment_plan: Accepted by the COO: residual risk Low

threat_event: Stolen MDC is used to view CAD incidents because it signs in automatically
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Per-vehicle automatic CAD login on MDCs
existing_controls: Vehicles locked when unattended; MDC mounts locked
treatment_plan: Crew sign-in to the CAD mobile client at shift start; remote disable of MDC accounts

threat_event: A patient care record or PCS is faxed or emailed to the wrong facility
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Manual fax and email; no verification step
existing_controls: Fax cover sheets
treatment_plan: Use the ePCR hospital delivery portal as the default; saved facility contacts; training

threat_event: HHS OCR enforcement after a breach because no risk analysis was ever documented
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No documented risk analysis before 2026
existing_controls: 2026 risk analysis completed (this register)
treatment_plan: Annual risk analysis update; retain 6 years

threat_event: Medicare denies or recoups claims because PCS and medical necessity documentation cannot be produced
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: PCS forms in a shared mailbox; no retention schedule; no link to the claim
existing_controls: Billing staff attach some PCS images to claims
treatment_plan: Attach every PCS to the billing record; 7-year retention rule in the retention schedule

threat_event: A patient care record is not available to the receiving hospital within 48 hours of a request
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No monitoring of hospital delivery; no paper fallback defined
existing_controls: ePCR vendor hospital portal; crews give a verbal report at handoff
treatment_plan: Paper PCR and abbreviated record in downtime kits; weekly delivery exception report

threat_event: Compromise of the MSP remote management tool gives attackers access to every endpoint and the cloud tenant
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: MSP tool has unrestricted access; no MSP security review
existing_controls: BAA with MSP
treatment_plan: MFA and source restrictions on MSP tooling; annual MSP security review with a SOC 2 report or questionnaire

threat_event: Cloud administrator account taken over through MFA fatigue or phishing
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Two admins with standing access; authenticator push MFA
existing_controls: MFA on the cloud console
treatment_plan: Phishing-resistant hardware keys for administrators; number matching for all push MFA

threat_event: A device on the crew lounge Wi-Fi reaches a dispatch console
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Flat headquarters network
existing_controls: Firewall at the internet edge
treatment_plan: Separate dispatch, office, and guest segments

threat_event: Staff do not report a suspected incident, so breach clocks are missed
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No reporting channel; no training
existing_controls: None
treatment_plan: Publish the reporting line; include in training and shift briefings

threat_event: Cardiac monitor relay service outage stops 12-lead ECG transmission to hospitals
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single relay service
existing_controls: Crews phone findings to the hospital; BAA in place
treatment_plan: Accepted by the COO: residual risk Low

threat_event: Power outage at Station 2 takes down its network and Wi-Fi
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No generator at Station 2
existing_controls: Tablets work offline; crews use cellular
treatment_plan: Accepted by the COO: residual risk Low

threat_event: Telephony denial of service floods the request lines so facilities cannot book transports
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: One inbound number range with the hosted phone vendor
existing_controls: County PSAP reaches dispatch by radio and CAD-to-CAD
treatment_plan: Unpublished alternate numbers for hospitals and the county; vendor call-flood protection

threat_event: A dispatcher edits unit status times in CAD to meet county response-time standards
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Shared logins; no CAD audit review; edit rights not restricted
existing_controls: Supervisor spot checks of late calls
treatment_plan: Restrict time edits to supervisors with a reason code; monthly edit report

threat_event: Billing records are altered to bill a higher service level than the ePCR documents
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Billing users can edit the service level after import from the ePCR
existing_controls: Monthly coding sample by the Billing and Compliance Manager
treatment_plan: Lock the imported service level; exception report of changes reviewed monthly

threat_event: Security documentation and incident records are not retained for 6 years
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No retention rule for security records
existing_controls: None
treatment_plan: Add to the retention schedule (with the Medicare and state rules in R-019)

threat_event: A ransom is paid to a sanctioned party under pressure to restore CAD
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No written ransom decision rule
existing_controls: None
treatment_plan: POL-03 4.7 decision rule: owner, counsel, insurer, and OFAC check; manual dispatch drills reduce pressure

threat_event: Attacker exploits a flaw in the integration engine's county-facing listener
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Listener accepts inbound connections; guest OS hardening not documented
existing_controls: Inbound allowed only from the county address range
treatment_plan: Hardening baseline; monthly patching; vulnerability scanning; move the link to a site-to-site VPN with the county

threat_event: The county asks the company to view law enforcement premise or warrant data, bringing criminal justice information into CAD without CJIS controls
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No process to assess new data feeds before they are connected
regulatory_driver: C-EMERGENCY-R01 (only if CJI is accessed); 28 CFR 20.33(a)(7)
existing_controls: Interface carries incident data only
treatment_plan: Decline any CJI feed unless a CJIS compliance program and agreement are in place first; review each new interface
